title: Terrordale
wikitext:
[[Image:Terrordale.jpg|thumb|Terrordale]]
[[Terrordale]], nestling in the northwest corner of [[Eastern Plaguelands]], is now a ghost town, one of the first to be overrun by the [[Scourge]]. It lies west of [[Plaguewood]] and [[Stratholme]], near the entrance to a tunnel that leads to the banks of the [[Thondroril River]].

Much like the town of [[Darkshire]] may once have been called [[Sunnydale]], [[Terrordale]] likely had a much less morbid name before the invasion of the [[Scourge]]. The game and its associated [[lore]] give no clues as to the haunted town's previous name.

No facilities in [[Terrordale]] remain for players to use, aside for one delusional fungi merchant, but there are a few quests to be obtained or carried out here.

This area is some particular interest to those that are collecting [[Crypt Fiend Parts]], as [[Crypt Fiend]]s are very common in Terrordale and its nearby cave, [[Terrorweb Tunnel]].  Wandering the withered grounds of this area is also the neutral level 60 [[Plagued Swine]], considered a very good choice as a pet for Hunters.
